spans.s: वि-चाकसत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. See s. v.

विचाकशत् वि-चाकशत्, अत्, अती, अत् (Intens.
part. fr. rt. काश् with वि), Ved. shining very brightly,
resplendent; seeing, perceiving, beholding.
वि-चक्रमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. striding, traversing.

विच् विच्, cl. 7. 3. P. A. विनक्ति (1st
sing. विनच्मि, 2nd sing. विनक्षि, 3rd
pl. विञ्चन्ति), विङ्क्ते, वेवेक्ति (3rd du. विविक्तस्,
Ṛg-veda
VIII. 12, 24

), वेविक्ते (?), विवेच, विविचे,
वेक्ष्यति, -ते, अविचत्, अवैक्षीत्, अविक्त, वेक्तुम्,
to divide, separate, sever; to remove from, deprive
of (with inst.); to discriminate, discern, judge: Pass.
विच्यते, Aor. अवेचि: Caus. वेचयति, Aor. अवीविचत्:
Desid. विविक्षति; [cf. Gr. εἴκω, (perhaps also)
ἑκάς, ἴχ-ν-ος; Lat. vito for vic-(i)-to, (according
to some also) vinco, vicis, invicem, vicissim; Old
Germ. wichan, (perhaps also) wehsal; Angl. Sax.
wican, wrixl.]

विचकिल वि-चकिल, अस्, m. a kind of jas-
[]
mine; another flowering plant (Artemisia, commonly
called Dona); a particular shrub, Vangueria Spinosa.

विचक्ष् वि-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्टुम्,
to appear, shine (Ved.); to see distinctly, view, look
at (Ved.); to perceive, descry, observe (Ved.); to
make manifest (Ved.); to tell, declare, proclaim,
announce: Caus. -चक्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
see distinctly, make clear (Ved.).

वि-चक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, clear-seeing, far-sighted,
all-seeing, discerning, circumspect, knowing, clever,
wise, sensible; able, proficient, skilful, (कार्य-व्˚,
clever or skilful in managing affairs); (अस्), m. a
learned Brāhman, Paṇḍit, a holy teacher; (आ), f. a
sort of sun-flower (= नाग-दन्ती).

वि-चक्षस्, आस्, m. a teacher, preceptor, spiritual
instructor.

विचक्षुस् वि-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, eyeless, des-
titute of sight, blind; perplexed, sad; (उस्), m. a
proper N.
विचतुर वि-चतुर, अस्, आ, अम्, see Vopa-deva
VI. 29
विचय वि-चय, &c. See p. 914, col. 1.

वि-चय, अस्, m. search, searching for, research,
investigation.

विचर् वि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, to
move or spread in different directions (Ved.); to go
or move about, wander, roam, rove, ramble about;
to go or gad about wantonly (Manu
IX. 20

), wander
from the right path; to go or walk through, run
through, pass through, pervade; to march against,
attack; to run out, come to an end; to go about
with, associate or have intercourse with (with inst.);
to proceed, act; to conduct one's self, behave, live;
to make, do, perform, accomplish; to go badly, fail:
Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go or roam
about; to cause to wander from the right path, se-
duce; to reflect, consider, deliberate, ponder, excogi-
tate; to examine, investigate, ascertain; to doubt,
be doubtful, hesitate.

वि-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wandering, roaming, going
about; marching; acting, making, performing.

वि-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or roamed about, &c.;
(अम्), n. roaming, roving about, wandering.

वि-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, deliberated about, considered,
examined, inquired into, discussed, judged; decided,
determined; (अम्), n. deliberation, discussion.

वि-चार, अस्, m. deliberation, discussion, consider-
ation, reflection, investigation, examination, trial,
disputation, dispute; the exercise of judgment or
reason, discriminating, distinguishing, judging, dis-
crimination, judgment, selection, decision, determin-
ation; doubt, hesitation; prudence.
—विचार-कर्तृ,
ता, m. one who makes investigation, a judge, investi-
gator.
—विचार-चिन्तामणि, N. of a work on gram-
mar.
—विचार-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing how to
discriminate or judge, able to decide on the merits
of a case, a judge.
—विचार-भू, ऊस्, f. a place for
discussion, any place for deliberation or judicial in-
vestigation, a tribunal; the judgment-seat of Yama
(judge of the dead).
—विचार-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्,
foolish or mistaken in judgment.
—विचार-शास्त्र,
अम्, n., N. of a work.
—विचार-शील, अस्, आ, अम्,
disposed to deliberation or reflection, considerate,
deliberative, reflective, thoughtful.
—विचार-स्थल,
अम्, n. a place for discussion or investigation, tribunal;
a logical disputation.
—विचारार्थ-समागम (˚र-
अर्˚), अस्, m. assembling for the sake of trial or judg-
ment, an assembly for investigation or discussion.
विचार वि-चार. See p. 913, col. 3.
वि-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, moving away from.

वि-चारक, अस्, m. an investigator, discriminator,
judge.
—विचारक-ता, f. or विचारक-त्व, अम्, n.
investigation, deliberation, discussion.
वि-चारक; add — a spy.

वि-चारण, अम्, आ, n. f. deliberation, considera-
tion, examination, discussion, investigation, the exer-
cise of judgment; hesitation, doubt; (आ), f. the
Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy, (see मीमांसा.)

वि-चारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deliberated about,
to be discussed or investigated.

1. वि-चार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deliberated, to be
weighed or discussed, &c.; questionable, doubtful.

2. वि-चार्य, ind. having deliberated, having con-
sidered, &c.

वि-चार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being investigated or
discussed, being under inquiry.

वि-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, gone through, wandered
through; occupied or inhabited by; entered.
विचीर्ण वि-चीर्ण. See col. 1.

विचर्चिका वि-चर्चिका, f. cutaneous erup-
tion, itch, herpes, scab.

विचर्चित वि-चर्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed,
smeared, anointed, rubbed with fragrant unguents,
applied (as an unguent).

विचर्षणि वि-चर्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (see चर्-
षणि), Ved. seeing through, far-seeing, discerning,
gifted with discernment, all-beholding, (Sāy. = विशे-
षेण सर्वस्य द्रष्टृ); swift, active.

विचल् वि-चल्, cl. 1. P. -चलति, -चलितुम्, to
move about, move to and fro, shake, waver, totter,
tremble; to move or go away, depart from, swerve
or deviate from (with abl.), go astray; to fall off
or down; to be agitated or troubled: Caus. -चाल-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to move about, shake, wave,
cause to tremble, make unsteady, trouble; to cause
to go away or depart from, cause to turn off or swerve
from, detach from, lead away from; to excite, stir
up; to destroy, rescind.

वि-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving about, shaking,
wavering, tottering, unsteady, unfixed; conceited.
वि-चाल, अस्, आ, अम्, coming between, intervening.

वि-चलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, moving about, going to
and fro, shaking, waving.

वि-चलन, अम्, n. the act of moving or going
away from, deviating from, deviation; unsteadiness,
fickleness; conceit, self-praise.

वि-चालन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to go away, ruining,
destroying.

वि-चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or moved away, de-
parted, swerved, deviated from.

विचि 1. वि-चि (see rt. 1. चि), cl. 5. P. A.
-चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to segregate, separate or
sever from (a mass), divide, select, pick out; to take
away, remove, efface, destroy (Ved.); to clear, pre-
pare (a way or road; in this sense the form विचि-
यन्तु is used in Ṛg-veda
2. वि-चि, इस्, m. f. a wave (= वीची, q. v.).

विचि 3. वि-चि (see rt. 2. चि; cf. वि-चित्), cl.
5. P. A. (Ved. also cl. 3. P.) -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चि-
केति, -चेतुम्, to discern, distinguish, make anything
discernible or clear, cause to appear; to search
through, investigate, inspect, examine; to search for,
look for, long for.
वि-ची, f. a wave (= 2. वि-चि above).
वीचि वीचि, इस्, m. f. (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 72

. fr. rt. वे), a wave, small wave, ripple; in-
constancy, thoughtlessness; pleasure, delight, happi-
ness; leisure, interval, rest; a ray of light; small,
little.
—वीचि-क्षोभ, अस्, m. agitation or roughness
of waves.
—वीचि-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘wave-garlanded,’ the
ocean.

वीची, f. = वीचि above.
—वीची-तरङ्ग-न्याय, अस्,
m. wave-undulation-method, (according to the Bhā-
ṣā-pariccheda 166 and Siddhānta-muktāvalī, p. 103,
the cause of the production of sound in the ear.)

वि-चयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. removing most
effectually, effacing, (Sāy. = अति-शयेन नाशक.)

1. वि-चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, selecting, picking out;
gathering together, collecting (as winnings &c.).

2. वि-चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, searching for, searching,
seeking, considering, investigating, discriminating.

वि-चयन, अम्, n. the act of searching for, search,
research, seeking.

वीचयन वी-चयन, अम्, n. (for वि-चयन,
see under 3. वि-चि, p. 914), research, inquiry.
वि-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, searched through, searched.

वि-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, perceived, observed, perceiv-
able, manifest.

वि-चिति, इस्, f. searching, search, research, consider-
ation.

विचिन्वत्क, अस्, m. search, discrimination, judg-
ment; a hero.

वि-चिन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, searching for, searching,
considering, deliberating, thinking.

वि-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, discernible, distinguishable;
to be searched for.
—विचेय-तारक, अस्, आ, अम्,
[]
having stars which have to be searched for, i. e.
separated by long intervals (= विरल-नक्षत्र).

विचित् वि-चित् (see rt. 4. चित्, which is pro-
bably connected with rt. 2. चि; cf. 3. वि-चि), cl. 1. P.
A. -चेतति, -ते, -चेतितुम्, to perceive, notice, observe,
know, comprehend, understand, distinguish; to be
perceived or known (A.), to appear: Caus., Ved.
-चितयति, -यितुम्, to perceive, distinguish: Desid.
-चिकित्सति, to wish to distinguish; to reflect, consider,
ponder; to hesitate about, doubt, be uncertain.

वि-चिकित्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, doubting, being in doubt
or uncertainty.
वि-चिकित्सा, f. doubt, uncertainty; error, mistake.

विचित्र वि-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated,
diversified, speckled, spotted, party-coloured, various,
varied, motley; painted, coloured; handsome, beauti-
ful; wonderful, surprising; (आ), f. a white deer; (अम्),
n. a variegated colour, party-colour; surprise; speech
implying apparently the reverse of the meaning in-
tended.
—विचित्र-चरित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, behaving in
a wonderful manner.
—विचित्र-चीनांशुक, अम्, n.
variegated China cloth; shot or watered China silk.
—विचित्र-ता, f. or विचित्र-त्व, अम्, n. variegation,
variety of colour, &c., spottedness; variety, diversity;
wonderfulness, wonder.
—विचित्र-देह, अस्, ई, अम्,
having a variegated or painted body; elegantly
formed; (अस्), m. a cloud.
—विचित्र-रूप, अस्, आ,
अम्, having various forms or diversified aspects,
various, diverse.
—विचित्र-वीर्य, अस्, m., N. of a
celebrated king of the lunar race (descended in
regular line from Soma, Purūravas, Puru, Dushyanta,
Bharata, Kuru, and lastly Śāntanu, who was his
father, his mother being Satyavatī; the latter before
her marriage with Śāntanu had borne a son, named
Vyāsa, to the sage Parāśara, which son, when his
half-brother Vicitra-vīrya died childless, married his
two widows and by them became the father of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra and Pāṇḍu).
—विचित्रवीर्य-सू, ऊस्,
f. epithet of Satyavatī (mother of Vicitra-vīrya by
Śāntanu and of Vyāsa by Parāśara).
—विचित्राङ्ग
(˚र-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having variegated or beautiful
limbs, having a spotted body, well-formed, elegant,
handsome; (अस्), m. a peacock; a tiger.

विचित्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, wonderful, surprising; (अस्),
m. the birch tree; (अम्), n. wonder, astonishment.

वि-चित्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, variegated, spotted, coloured,
painted; wonderful.

विचिन्त् वि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यि-
तुम्, to perceive, discern, observe (Ved.); to think
of, reflect or muse upon (with acc.); to consider,
ponder, regard, care for; to find out, devise, investi-
gate; to imagine.

वि-चिन्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, thinking about, brood-
ing over.

वि-चिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thought of, meditated on,
considered.

1. वि-चिन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thought about or
imagined.
2. वि-चिन्त्य, ind. having thought or reflected upon.

वि-चिन्त्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thought of or
considered.

विचुम्ब् वि-चुम्ब्, cl. 1. P. -चुम्बति, -चुम्बि-
तुम्, to kiss, kiss warmly.

विचूर्ण् वि-चूर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -चूर्णयति, -यि-
तुम्, to grind, pound, pulverize, crush to pieces.

वि-चूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or dashed to
pieces, shattered, smashed.

विचृत् वि-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्,
Ved. to untie, detach, disconnect, loosen, open, spread
out, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

. वि-
चृतन्ति = स्तुतीर् ग्रथ्नन्ति, they string together
or compose praises.)

वि-चृत्, त्, f., Ved. loosing, releasing, B. R., (Sāy.
= विमुक्त.)

वि-चृतौ, m. du. ‘two releasers,’ N. of two stars
the rising of which promotes relief from disease.

वि-चृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. opened, spread, (Sāy.
= प्रसारित.)

विचेतन वि-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, senseless,
unconscious, lifeless, inanimate, dead.

वि-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, senseless, mindless, ignorant,
stupid; sad, perplexed, unhappy; wise (Ved.).

विचेष्ट् वि-चेष्ट्, cl. 1. P. A. -चेष्टति, -ते,
-चेष्टितुम्, to move the limbs about, writhe, wallow,
struggle, stretch, sprawl; to exert one's self; to bestir
one's self, strive, be active, act; to struggle or act against
(with loc.); to conduct or behave one's self: Caus.
-चेष्टयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, rouse to action.

वि-चेष्टत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, struggling, making exer-
tion, striving; sprawling.

वि-चेष्टमान, अस्, आ, अम्, struggling, writhing,
striving, exerting one's self.

वि-चेष्टयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting in motion,
rousing to action.

वि-चेष्टा, f. movement, effort, exertion, conduct,
behaviour.

वि-चेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, struggled, striven, tried,
endeavoured, acted, exerted, done; investigated, in-
quired into; acted badly, done foolishly, misdone,
ill-judged; = 2. वि-गत; (अम्), n. exertion, enter-
prise, effort, undertaking; action, act; gesture; sen-
sation (e. g. अनङ्ग-विचेष्टितम्, a thrilling sensa-
tion or movement produced by love); evil or malicious
act, machination, trickery.

विच्छद् 1. वि-च्छद् (see rt. 1. छद्), cl. 10. P.
-च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to uncover, unclothe, undress.

विच्छद् 2. वि-च्छद् (see rt. 3. छद्), cl. 10.
P. A. or Caus. -छन्दयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to render
or return homage (?).

वि-च्छन्द or वि-च्छन्दक, अस्, m. a building
consisting of several stories and surrounded by a
portico; a palace, temple.

वि-च्छन्दस् (?), an inferior kind of metre; [cf.
छन्दस्.]

विच्छर्दक वि-च्छर्दक, अस्, m. (= वि-च्छन्-
दक above), a large building, temple, palace; [cf.
2. छर्दिस्.]

विच्छर्दन वि-च्छर्दन, अम्, n. (said to be
fr. rt. छृद् with वि), the act of vomiting, ejecting,
disregarding; wasting (?).

वि-च्छर्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited, ejected; disre-
garded, neglected; diminished, impaired.

विच्छाय 2. वि-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see
p. 909, col. 1), destitute of shadow, shadowless; (अस्),
m. a jewel, gem.

वि-च्छायय, Nom. P. -च्छाययति, &c., to free
from shadow.

विच्छिद् वि-च्छिद् (see rt. 1. छिद्), cl. 7. P.
A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to cut or tear
asunder, cleave or split in two, break asunder, divide,
separate; to cut off, break off; to interrupt, inter-
cept, disturb; to destroy; to be divided (Ved.):
Pass. -च्छिद्यते, to be cut asunder; to be cut off or
destroyed; to come to an end, cease.

वि-च्छित्ति, इस्, f. cutting asunder, dividing, sepa-
rating, separation; cutting off, excision; breaking
off, fracture; interruption, cessation; absence, disap-
pearance, loss, destruction; cesura, pause in a verse;
boundary, limit (as of a house &c.); N. of certain
amorous gestures practised by a mistress or heroine
in a drama (described as irregularity or carelessness
in dress and decoration); colouring or marking the
body with coloured unguents.

वि-च्छिद्य, ind. having cut asunder; having se-
parated; separatively, interruptedly, (विच्छिद्य वि-
च्छिद्य, on separate occasions.)

वि-च्छिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being cut off, being
destroyed or exterminated.

वि-च्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut asunder, severed, se-
parated, divided, parted, scattered, distributed, por-
tioned, shared; cut off; broken off, broken, inter-
rupted, prevented, intercepted, ceased, ended, termi-
[]
nated; hidden, absent; variegated, diversified, coloured,
anointed, smeared or marked with unguents; crooked,
curved.
—विच्छिन्न-धूम-प्रसर, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the free course of the smoke interrupted.

वि-च्छेद, अस्, m. cutting asunder, dividing, sepa-
ration, disjunction, cutting off, breaking off, breaking,
interruption, termination; prohibition, prevention,
removal; the division of a book, a section, chapter;
dissension, difference; space, interval.

वि-च्छेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, cutting asunder, di-
viding, separating, &c.; (अस्), m. a cutter off, divider,
sector.

वि-च्छेदन, अम्, n. the act of cutting asunder,
severing, dividing, separating, &c.; destruction.

वि-च्छेदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut asunder, to
be divided or separated, &c.; divisible.

विच्छुर् वि-च्छुर् (see rt. छुर्), cl. 6. P.
-च्छुरति, -च्छुरितुम्, to inlay; to overspread.

वि-च्छुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, inlaid; coated, overspread,
covered; anointed, besmeared; suffused.

विच्छो वि-च्छो (see rt. छो), Caus. -च्छा-
ययति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cut about, wound.

विच्यु वि-च्यु, cl. 1. A. -च्यवते, -च्योतुम्, to
fall asunder, fall to pieces, split in two, perish; to fall
or depart from, deviate or swerve from (with abl.);
to fall off or down, decline; to fail, err, make a mis-
take; to displace (Ved.): Caus. -च्यावयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to fall to pieces, throw down, destroy.

वि-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen apart, fallen down,
slipped off; fallen or deviated from, displaced, thrown
down; (in surgery) separated from the living part,
sloughed.

वि-च्युति, इस्, f. falling to pieces; downfall, deca-
dence, decline; deviation from; severance, separa-
tion; failure, miscarriage, (गर्भ-व्˚, miscarriage
of the fetus.)
वि-चिकित्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, doubted about, questioned.
वि-चिन्तन, अम्, n. thinking about; discernment.
वि-चिन्ता, f. thought, regard, care, anxiety.
वि-चूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having no top-knot.
विच्चिक, अस्, m. a particular bird.
